h1: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Mangalore

h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Mangalore

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Mangalore

c: Mangalore gets some of the heaviest monsoon rain of any Indian city, and anyone planning an outdoor gym here should think about water first. FunPlay Systems is an outdoor gym equipment supplier in Mangalore for the city corporation's parks, colleges, hospitals, housing complexes and the beachfront. We build the machines at our Vasai factory, about 750 km up the coast, and send them south by road.

Mangalore is a port city and an education centre, with many medical and engineering colleges on large campuses. Salt air, humidity and laterite soil are the local conditions. Our frames are galvanised, which suits the coast, and machines near the sea need a fresh-water rinse from time to time. We plan installation for the dry months, since grouted footings need dry weather to set. Our team or a dealer in south India handles fixing.

facts.label: Delivery and installation

items.q: When should we install an outdoor gym in Mangalore?
items.a: Before or after the main monsoon, usually from October to May. Grouted concrete needs dry days to set, so we plan dispatch to match a dry spell.

items.q: Will laterite soil affect the footings?
items.a: Laterite is firm when dry and holds a footing well. Our installer cuts a level pit, grouts the machine in concrete and leaves a small apron so rain does not wash soil away.

items.q: Can a medical college order equipment for students and staff?
items.a: Yes. Tell us the number of users and the area available. We will suggest a mix of strength and stretching machines and send a layout drawing with clear space marked.
